commits.summary: Record eight ordinary Spring decisions and measured startup costs
commits.body:
Merge the four passed verification jobs and rebuild the Spring scorecard from their bound artifacts. Ordinary native decisions rose from four to eight of sixteen: seven establishments and one refutation. Both historical property-name JARs reached the public observer without supplied application state. The three different parent component names reproduced individually. The complete primary recheck retained 148 raw outcomes, including all 128 legacy role proofs.

The full binder and transfer graphs advance to URL.getPath after opening the factory stream. Both prove the same 161 bytes and EOF separately. The fluent guard holds on the measured LF and CRLF launches and remains open for an unspecified startup separator. Both formatter slices now first need Class.getGenericInterfaces for the actual Number-to-Number converter factory. The report identifies these operations and the bound JVM inputs for each.

Equal-scope metadata trials ran six selectors per historical artifact in both route orders. The full routes took 6.18 s ordinary versus 19.72 s recorded, then 24.99 s recorded versus 7.83 s ordinary. All 48 results agree. Both conformance corpus tests passed on their first run, in a 24m45s step. The four example validators, 59 selected Rust test binaries and 28 Python suites passed. Both scorecards and eight oracle tables were regenerated or checked, the data scorecard stayed byte-identical, 175 local documentation links resolved, and twelve altered evidence records plus seven bytecode changes were rejected.
